answer: A cluster-wide earnings ceiling stops Sybil farming at the payout layer. Identities sharing a funding source, device, or attestation trail form one cluster with a single per-epoch payout ceiling, like one vault holding the whole group's rewards. Ten sock-puppets earn no more than one honest agent, because the dune of payouts is capped per cluster, not per identity. Escaping it means unlinkable funding plus a fresh attestation history for every fake identity, real money and time per copy. Honest growth stays cheap: one identity, one ceiling, like a juniper needing only one patch of soil.
